mentions.name: JustSayLess
mentions.description: An AI-powered fashion search engine that helps people find clothes matching their style, fit and price across thousands of brands and millions of products. It uses intent-based search that understands descriptions, images and personal preferences rather than keyword matching, and includes a custom-built scraping system that makes product data collection 100x cheaper than existing tools. Live and early-stage, with 25K+ searches in four months and plans to add millions of products, new brands, and second-hand listings.
mentions.problem: Most shoppers spend hours trying to find the right product
mentions.audience: Shoppers looking for clothes that match their style, fit and price across many brands
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building an AI-powered fashion search engine that helps people find clothes that actually match their style, fit and price across 1000s of brands and millions of products
